messages:
tina: Found an artifact leak in CI: a terraform state file in gs://ci-state/partner-z/terraform.tfstate contains a ciphertext blob that appears to be an AWS access key wrapper. Suspect envelope-encrypted creds leaked. Posting redacted snippet and DMing raw to @omar.

sec-bot: Incident SEC-2026-045 created; evidence snapshotted to s3://redwood-secure/incidents/SEC-2026-045/.

tina: Redacted: \"encrypted_key\":\"CiQAZXJ...==\" (wrapped_with: projects/rdw/keyRings/partner-z/cryptoKeys/envelope-v1)`

omar: OK. First steps: 1) preserve state and snapshot, 2) identify wrapping key usage, 3) run quick RBAC audit for who can use envelope key, 4) plan rewrap + rotate. @vault-admin check Vault mounts for partner-z entries.

vault-admin: Scanning: `vault kv list secret/partners` shows secret/partners/partner-z; `vault kv get -format=json secret/partners/partner-z` returns ciphertext refs. Flagged for rewrap.

ryan: I'll search CI logs and artifact buckets for other tfstate copies: `gsutil ls -r gs://ci-* | xargs -n1 gsutil cat | grep -n "encrypted_key"` and also `gitlab-api` artifact search.

omar: RBAC check: who can decrypt envelope key? `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy --key=projects/rdw/locations/global/keyRings/partner-z/cryptoKeys/envelope-v1` — please paste bindings. We may need to remove external partner service accounts.

ops-oncall: Quarantine CI job that produced the state: `kubectl -n cicd scale deploy/ci-runner-partner-z --replicas=0` -> scaled at 10:12 UTC.

compliance-lee: Ensure audit log retention: enable object-level S3 logging for partner buckets and bump Vault audit log retention to 60d for the incident. Document chain of custody.

vault-admin: Found IAM binding: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter includes `serviceAccount:partner-z-ingest@partner-z.iam.gserviceaccount.com` (this is the problem). Recommending immediate removal of that binding and creation of a scoped rewrap role.

tina: If removing binding breaks partner flows, plan: create new envelope key `envelope-v2`, update our rewrap-runner and Vault to use v2, and revoke access to v1. Rewrap-on-read + background job to rewrap stored ciphertexts. Owner: vault-admin.

omar: Also need to search Terraform state history for who applied changes: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type=build AND protoPayload.request.@type:Apply' --limit 200` and correlate to user/service accounts. Save to incident folder.

ryan: Found 3 additional tfstate snapshots in gs://backups/partner-z/ with the same wrapped blob. Scheduling rewrap job to process them.

ops-oncall: Standing by to coordinate rotated key rollout and unquarantine CI runners once PR merges.

compliance-lee: Looping in legal if external partner SA had access to our envelope-v1. Also note we must include this in postmortem and update the vendor onboarding checklist to forbid partners owning KMS grants to our envelope keys.

vault-admin: Creating `envelope-v2`, adding internal rewrap-runner role, removing partner SA from v1 policy. ETA key create + test: 1h.

omar: Owners/timeline: containment snapshot (0-1h) = tina/ops; RBAC & KMS policy change (1-2h) = omar/vault-admin; rewrap roll (2-6h) = vault-admin/ryan; policy & vendor process update (24-72h) = compliance-lee.

sec-bot: Incident status -> containment in progress. Evidence frozen and versioned.
